title: Longitudinal AI Preparedness Index (L-AIPI) Dataset: 2000–2023
description: An open-access macroeconomic panel dataset tracking national artificial intelligence readiness across 149 developing economies from 2000 to 2023. Grounded in the multi-pillar conceptual framework of the IMF AI Preparedness Index (AIPI), L-AIPI reconstructs continuous time-varying readiness scores across digital infrastructure, human capital, and innovation pillars to enable longitudinal econometric estimation and climate resilience modeling.
